svg.title: Docent dense classifier model
svg.desc: Stages from the padded feature row to the two heads with shapes and parameter counts, then the example query's intent probabilities and top-3 destinations.
svg.text: DENSE DOCENT -- features, pooled embedding, hidden layer, two heads
WHAT: 26003 parameters; a query touches about 1664 of them (its feature rows plus the body and heads).
example where is the cosmac demo
intent probabilities [navigate explain recommend story status unsupported] 1 0 0 0 0 0
The catalog then supplies the title, breadcrumb, URL, and story for the predicted place; the model never emits text.
WHY: the model predicts meaning only (an intent and a destination distribution); the campus catalog stays the authority
for facts, so a stale model can never invent an exhibit, and a wrong pick is a wrong link rather than a false sentence.
WHY: a flat dense classifier is the baseline every routed docent (CD02, CD03) is measured against for the same corpus.
HOW: embed(1024, 24), chain(linear(24, 32), relu_layer()), linear(32, 6), linear(32, 13); loss = intent CE + destination CE;
one adam step per training row per epoch (lr 0.003, 40 epochs); u:docent_loss inlines through the tape (finding F2).
Bytes: 208024 at f64, 26003 at INT8 (payload, projected); the export of step 4 measures the real file.
Models are globals (finding F7: a model cannot be a user-function argument); the library names them docent_emb and so on.
Train, validation, and timing numbers are in the docent results table, never drawn here, so this diagram stays byte-stable.
